title: Many a Son shares an uplifting new single, "Waxwings"
htmlContent: Many a Son is taking listeners on an exciting musical journey with their new single "Waxwings," part of their ongoing project called Lost in Season. This lively track, featured in their Winter EP, beautifully captures the spirit of change that comes with the seasons, encouraging us to embrace adventure and renewal through its rich and cinematic sound. Named after the graceful birds, "Waxwings" features flowing melodies and vibrant instrumentals. It is a lively track with harmonious vocals, engaging rhythms, and moving storytelling. Many a Son skillfully connects nature with human emotions, pushing you to move forward, even when times are still. Alongside "Waxwings," they also released a companion piece called "Pine Cones," which presents a quieter, more comforting side of winter. In contrast, "Waxwings" captures the energy and excitement of exploring the world around us. These two songs set the tone for the Winter EP and mark an exciting chapter in the larger Lost in Season project. The duo's music reflects the stunning landscapes of the North Coast, and "Waxwings" beautifully highlights this. The song features a lush arrangement of sounds that mirror the movement of nature, reminding us that even in the coldest parts of winter, there's still vibrancy and life to be found. https://open.spotify.com/album/6pQ56MOg99GyI7Rw2FFeg5?si=Q-FwLt7aSDKNr1FQ8n59xg Many a Son demonstrates their talent for storytelling through music, creating both personal and expansive soundscapes. "Waxwings" invites listeners to enter the wild, trust in change, and let the music carry them away. With each new release, Many a Son establishes themselves as a unique voice in the alt-folk scene, and "Waxwings" showcases their ability to capture both the quiet moments and the lively bursts of each season.
